card.title: One Thing Leads to Another
card.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This dripping tap is our chance to replace the whole sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only needs a washer. I've bought one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We'll fit it while the sink's out and replace that swollen worktop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop runs under every cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll empty the kitchen. With the cupboards out, we can finally fix the layout.

mechanism: A uses a small tap fault and each linked repair dependency to justify an ever broader kitchen overhaul.
confusable: Unlike efficiently solving the original issue, each fact must become a reason for more disruptive work.
comparison: D48-a moves washer to sink to worktop to layout; D48-b moves chair to floor to counter and queue.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
